features: Added Formatted Number Filter on Paste to strip formatted spaces and thousands-separator commas when pasting numbers into scientific row math fields, while preserving function parameters.

Added Copy Row Expression as Excel-Compatible Formula via Microsoft Excel green copy buttons, complete with '=' prefixing, capitalized function names, and constant substitutions (pi -> PI(), e -> EXP(1)) with beautiful hover animations.
improvements: Decomposed monolithic UIManager god node into five modular, specialized sub-managers (ClipboardManager, DOMInitializer, InteractionController, MathFieldController, and StateRestorer) to prevent cyclic imports and increase testability.
fixes: Fixed changelog local state checking and matching triggers by bypassing cache on updates.
Implemented native controllerchange triggers in services/pwa.js to force page reloads on background update activation.
